scope: Read-only review of motorsim/periodic_initialization_v1.py, engineering workflow provenance binding and the A9000 source artifacts.

findings.source_anchor: Receipt-anchored result, checkpoint and invocation-manifest SHA-256 values are checked against bytes; the source checkpoint is restored only under its own exact source solver identity.
findings.compatibility: Geometry, topology, discretization, EOS, species, boundaries, combustion and solver controls are retained. The only admitted operating changes are reference RPM and the already-defined explicit fully-open power-valve endpoint hold.
findings.transfer: Chamber mass/internal energy/species, duct conservative states/species and network-volume mass/energy/species are mapped; target phase geometry and mesh topology are checked; total mass, energy and all species match exactly for this source.
findings.new_run: Clock, ledger, trace, combustion event history and periodicity detector restart cleanly at cycle 0. New target initialization identity and provenance are separate from exact checkpoint resume.
findings.fail_closed: Unrelated CFL or valve-map modifications and unsupported dynamic-reed state are rejected. No hash is generated to stand in for missing source evidence.
findings.observed_limit: The pilot became PERIOD_1_OBSERVED at cycle 15 but 102/413 cross-run observable comparisons fail, dominated by exhaust-duct species. Therefore no coordinator integration is recommended.

residual_risks: The mechanism supports the current static-reed topology; dynamic-reed state transfer is deliberately unsupported.
A local periodicity pass from the warm state does not prove convergence to the historical target state.
This review is SELF_REVIEW, not INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.
